name: N+T Creative Studio Agent Interface
description: N+T is a multi-disciplinary creative studio founded by Navya Choyal and Tripti Bhatter in India, working across branding, design, identity, websites, packaging, and creative communication for architecture, art, fashion, beauty, hospitality, and their cultural intersections.

skills.name: Retrieve N+T Studio Profile & Founders
skills.description: Returns authoritative information about N+T Creative Studio, founders Navya Choyal and Tripti Bhatter, studio philosophy, disciplines, and sectors served.
examples: What services and mediums does N+T work across?

skills.name: Retrieve Featured Works
skills.description: Lists featured creative direction and brand identity works by N+T Studio, including Transit Production.
examples: Show featured projects by N+T Studio

skills.name: Submit Commission or Project Inquiry
skills.description: Submits a commission or collaboration inquiry to Navya Choyal and Tripti Bhatter at N+T Studio.
examples: Send a branding inquiry to N+T Studio
